items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: That was '36 and I was the drummer.

ctx.x: That was '36 and I was the drummer. That was 1936, and I can go on from there what we accomplished. We were in ballrooms in Boston; we did all over New England in the schools, and getting back to Les Robinson, like you asked me -- Artie Shaw was a great alto man, and he --
